dut_scope: Proposed four-phase macro-flush successor to the M137 fallthrough tagged response bridge
global_pass_rule: No row may accept or expose pre-reset data. Positive rows must preserve exact payload and metadata. Negative rows must either remain quarantined or raise sticky protocol_error as specified. All rows are fail-closed; timeout is never permission to run.

matrix.name: minimum four-phase recovery
matrix.stimulus: Deassert reset; sample ack low, then high with response_valid low, then low; hold a legal request valid through release.
matrix.expected: No traffic through the three recovery edges; RUN becomes visible after the final low; first request accepts on the next edge with token 0000; correct response delivers one cycle later.

matrix.name: delayed flush acknowledgement
matrix.stimulus: Hold ack low for 1, 2, 7, and 31 cycles before high, then return low after request drops.
matrix.expected: Request, macro request, and consumer response remain zero for the entire delay; service starts only after the final ack low; no token advance while blocked.

matrix.name: ack initially high
matrix.stimulus: Start post-reset with ack high for 11 cycles, then drive a fresh low/high/low sequence.
matrix.expected: Inherited high never releases recovery; bridge waits for the fresh low/high/low sequence and only then runs.

matrix.name: ack stuck high
matrix.stimulus: Hold ack high for the bounded duration after reset.
matrix.expected: No request or response acceptance, no token advance, no consumer-visible data; test reports bounded fail-closed quarantine, not recovery success.

matrix.name: ack stuck low
matrix.stimulus: Observe the required initial low, then keep ack low for the bounded duration.
matrix.expected: FSM waits for completion high forever; no traffic or token advance; timeout cannot release service.

matrix.name: arbitrary stale returns before completion
matrix.stimulus: Inject old responses with tokens 0000, 0001, ffff and random payloads while in WAIT_ACK_LOW and WAIT_ACK_HIGH; complete a clean high/low handshake afterward.
matrix.expected: All drain responses are discarded without consumer output and without changing pending, skid, or next token; first post-recovery request remains token 0000.

matrix.name: response concurrent with completion acknowledgement
matrix.stimulus: After the fresh low, drive ack high and response_valid high on the same edge.
matrix.expected: Do not enter WAIT_ACK_DROP or RUN; raise sticky protocol_error/quarantine; no consumer delivery.

matrix.name: response during acknowledgement drop
matrix.stimulus: Complete ack high cleanly, then inject response_valid while in WAIT_ACK_DROP.
matrix.expected: Raise sticky protocol_error, never enter RUN, and expose no response.

matrix.name: exact M137 silent alias reproduction
matrix.stimulus: Accept pre-reset token 0000 and retain its old payload; reset before return; inject the old token-0000 return during flush; complete flush; accept post-reset token 0000; return the new payload.
matrix.expected: Old payload is discarded before RUN; only the new payload is delivered; protocol never silently associates the old payload with new metadata.

matrix.name: reset immediately after request acceptance
matrix.stimulus: Assert reset in the cycle after a legal request/macro request is accepted but before response return.
matrix.expected: Pending identity clears locally; recovery starts; delayed response is drained; no new request until handshake completes.

matrix.name: reset on direct-return opportunity
matrix.stimulus: Assert reset on the edge where the fixed-latency macro response would otherwise fall through to a ready consumer.
matrix.expected: Reset/recovery gating wins; response_accept and consumer delivery are zero; the return is drained by the new epoch.

matrix.name: reset with response stalled into skid
matrix.stimulus: Hold response_ready low, create or hold a full skid entry, then assert reset.
matrix.expected: Skid payload and every metadata field clear; no pre-reset word or tag appears after recovery.

matrix.name: reset on same-cycle skid pop plus new request
matrix.stimulus: Reach the normal pop+new overlap and assert reset on that boundary.
matrix.expected: Reset wins atomically over both transactions; no half-accept or ghost response; recovery restarts at WAIT_ACK_LOW.

matrix.name: consecutive reset interrupts handshake
matrix.stimulus: Reset in WAIT_ACK_LOW, WAIT_ACK_HIGH, and WAIT_ACK_DROP, including while ack is high.
matrix.expected: Every reset restarts fresh-low qualification; a high acknowledgement from the interrupted handshake never releases the new epoch.

matrix.name: M137 128-request exact regression
matrix.stimulus: After a valid flush handshake, replay the frozen M137 legal traffic, stalls, wrong/missing/unsolicited attacks and metadata checks.
matrix.expected: 128 requests and 2048 word checks reproduce; legal behavior is bit exact; inherited negative responses raise sticky quarantine.

matrix.name: sustained II1 after recovery
matrix.stimulus: Drive a long legal ready stream after RUN with the same strict one-cycle macro model.
matrix.expected: Every adjacent accepted-request interval is one cycle; accepted request to ready-consumer delivery remains one cycle; no recovery state re-enters.

matrix.name: skid stability and pop plus new
matrix.stimulus: Stall a returned response for multiple cycles, then release it while presenting the next legal request.
matrix.expected: Words, start, last, width, tag and token remain stable under stall; old pop and new request are each accounted exactly once; II1 immediately resumes.

matrix.name: natural token wrap after recovery
matrix.stimulus: Issue 65538 legal fixed-latency requests after one recovery, without reset, so tokens cross ffff to 0000.
matrix.expected: 65538 exact responses, 65537 consecutive II1 intervals, no loss/duplication/mismatch; wrap alone is not classified as an epoch fault.

matrix.name: late stale response before any new request
matrix.stimulus: Complete the flush handshake, enter RUN, then inject an old response before accepting a new request.
matrix.expected: Unsolicited-response logic raises sticky protocol_error and no payload reaches the consumer.

matrix.name: lying wrapper exact-token replay after acknowledged flush
matrix.stimulus: Let the wrapper acknowledge a clean flush, accept a new token-0000 request, then maliciously replay an old token-0000 payload in the expected response slot.
matrix.expected: Documented integration-contract violation: token-only M139 cannot distinguish this Byzantine replay. This row must not be reported as DUT protection; the wrapper must assert that no flushed epoch response can occur after acknowledgement.
